name: Example - Vol-Targeted Risk Parity Across Asset Classes
hypothesis: Allocating across equity, bonds, gold, real estate and international equity in inverse-volatility proportion delivers a better risk-adjusted return than equal weighting, because asset-class volatilities differ persistently and are only weakly correlated.
_note: Demonstrates vol_target sizing in the portfolio block. 'signal' here is a constant-on (only hold assets) and the sizing layer does the real work.
